behavior: Sound has no row activity filter or reserved index; index 0 is a valid match.
Sound reads the live table pointer for every row and compares first name pointer only. All 1,600 rows are searched on failure.
Particle ignores reserved index 0. General preferred pass, active groups 0/1 pass, then any signed active group pass differ from fast lookup, which has no third pass.
General lookup excludes the requested index in every pass; fast lookup has no exclusion argument.
Preferred particle group uses only low 8 bits; signed stored group byte is used only for the general third-pass flag address.
Particle/audio matching folds ASCII a-z and bytes e0-ff by subtracting 32, with signed byte ordering in comparator projections.
